program.program_name: PM MUDRA - Shishu
program.description: Micro-credit for small income-generating businesses requiring loans up to Rs. 50,000.
program.benefit_summary: Collateral-free institutional credit up to Rs. 50,000.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Micro entrepreneurs

program.program_name: PM MUDRA - Kishore
program.description: Credit support for micro enterprises requiring more than Rs. 50,000 and up to Rs. 5 lakh.
program.benefit_summary: Collateral-free institutional credit above Rs. 50,000 and up to Rs. 5 lakh.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Micro entrepreneurs

program.program_name: PM MUDRA - Tarun
program.description: Credit support for micro enterprises requiring more than Rs. 5 lakh and up to Rs. 10 lakh.
program.benefit_summary: Collateral-free institutional credit above Rs. 5 lakh and up to Rs. 10 lakh.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Micro entrepreneurs

program.program_name: PM MUDRA - Tarun Plus
program.description: Credit support above Rs. 10 lakh and up to Rs. 20 lakh for entrepreneurs who have successfully repaid a previous Tarun loan.
program.benefit_summary: Collateral-free credit above Rs. 10 lakh and up to Rs. 20 lakh.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Existing micro entrepreneurs with repaid Tarun loan

program.program_name: Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
program.description: Credit-linked subsidy programme for setting up new micro enterprises in non-farm sectors.
program.benefit_summary: Credit-linked subsidy of 15% to 35% on project cost up to Rs. 50 lakh for manufacturing and Rs. 20 lakh for services.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: New individual entrepreneurs, SHGs, institutions

program.program_name: PMEGP 2nd Loan for Upgradation
program.description: Financial assistance for upgrading existing, well-performing PMEGP/MUDRA units.
program.benefit_summary: Subsidy of 15% to 20% on project cost up to Rs. 1 crore for manufacturing and Rs. 25 lakh for services.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Existing performing PMEGP units

program.program_name: PM Vishwakarma
program.description: End-to-end holistic support for traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 identified trades.
program.benefit_summary: Collateral-free enterprise credit up to Rs. 3 lakh (Rs. 1L first tranche + Rs. 2L second tranche) at 5% interest rate, plus Rs. 15,000 toolkit incentive.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools

program.program_name: PM SVANidhi
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
program.description: Micro credit facility for urban street vendors to resume livelihoods.
program.benefit_summary: Working capital loan up to Rs. 10,000 (1st tranche), Rs. 20,000 (2nd tranche), and Rs. 50,000 (3rd tranche) with 7% interest subsidy on timely repayment.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Urban street vendors and hawkers

program.program_name: NSFDC Micro Finance Scheme (MFS)
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
program.nodal_agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
program.description: Micro-finance through State Channelizing Agencies for small income-generating activities.
program.benefit_summary: Concessional micro credit up to Rs. 60,000 per beneficiary at 5% p.a. interest rate.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Scheduled Caste individuals living below double the poverty line

program.program_name: NSFDC Aajeevika Micro-Finance Yojana (AMY)
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
program.nodal_agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
program.description: Micro-finance routed through NBFC-MFIs for income-generating micro activities.
program.benefit_summary: Concessional micro finance up to Rs. 60,000 per beneficiary at interest rates not exceeding NBFC-MFI caps.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Scheduled Caste individuals living below double the poverty line

program.program_name: NSFDC Term Loan Scheme
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
program.nodal_agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
program.description: Term credit finance for commercially viable income-generating projects.
program.benefit_summary: Term loan assistance up to 90% of project cost for projects costing up to Rs. 50 lakh at concessional interest rates.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Scheduled Caste individuals living below double the poverty line

program.program_name: NSFDC Udyam Nidhi Yojana (UNY)
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
program.nodal_agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
program.description: Micro loans through cooperative societies and small finance entities for income generation.
program.benefit_summary: Micro loan assistance up to Rs. 44,000 per beneficiary at 4% p.a. interest rate.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Scheduled Caste individuals living below double the poverty line

program.program_name: Stand-Up India Scheme
program.description: Facilitates composite bank loans between Rs. 10 Lakh and Rs. 1 Crore to at least one SC/ST and one Woman borrower per bank branch for greenfield enterprises.
program.benefit_summary: Bank composite loan between Rs. 10 Lakh and Rs. 1 Crore with tenure up to 7 years and moratorium up to 18 months.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: SC, ST, and Women entrepreneurs setting up greenfield ventures

eligibility.notes: Greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services, agri-allied, or trading. In non-individual enterprises, 51% shareholding must be held by SC/ST or woman.

program.program_name: SIDBI Make in India Soft Loan Fund for MSMEs (SMILE)
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of MSME / Ministry of Finance
program.description: Provides quasi-equity and soft term loans to meet required debt-equity ratios for setting up new MSMEs and financing expansion/modernization.
program.benefit_summary: Soft term loan and quasi-equity assistance up to Rs. 25 Crore directly through SIDBI.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: New and existing MSMEs in 25 Make in India sectors

eligibility.notes: Enterprises in 25 Make in India manufacturing and service sectors.

program.program_name: NBCFDC New Swarnima Scheme for Women
program.description: Term loan assistance at concessional interest rate of 5% p.a. to backward class women entrepreneurs for self-employment.
program.benefit_summary: Term loan up to Rs. 2,00,000 at a concessional interest rate of 5% p.a.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Women entrepreneurs belonging to Backward Classes

eligibility.notes: Woman belonging to Backward Classes; family annual income ceiling up to Rs. 3 Lakh.

program.program_name: NSTFDC Adivasi Mahila Sashaktikaran Yojana (AMSY)
program.description: Concessional loan assistance exclusively for Scheduled Tribe women entrepreneurs undertaking self-employment ventures.
program.benefit_summary: Loan assistance up to Rs. 2,00,000 at a subsidized interest rate of 4% p.a.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Scheduled Tribe (ST) women entrepreneurs

eligibility.notes: Scheduled Tribe (ST) woman; family income up to Rs. 3 Lakh.

program.program_name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
program.description: Provides third-party credit guarantee cover to Member Lending Institutions extending collateral-free loans to MSEs.
program.benefit_summary: Credit guarantee coverage between 75% and 85% for loans up to Rs. 10 Crore without third-party collateral.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: New and existing Micro and Small Enterprises

eligibility.notes: Micro and Small enterprises; agriculture and educational institutions excluded.

guarantee.eligible_lending_institutions: Scheduled Commercial Banks, RRBs, NBFCs, Small Finance Banks

program.program_name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Subordinate Debt (CGSSD)
program.description: Guarantee cover to banks for extending subordinate debt up to 15% of promoter equity or Rs. 75 Lakh to promoters of stressed/NPA MSME units.
program.benefit_summary: 90% guarantee cover on subordinate debt up to Rs. 75 Lakh for stressed MSME revival.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Promoters of stressed and NPA MSME units

eligibility.notes: Operational MSME accounts classified as SMA-2 or NPA.

program.program_name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups (CGSS)
program.description: Credit guarantee coverage for loans and venture debt extended by financial institutions to DPIIT-recognized startups.
program.benefit_summary: Credit guarantee coverage up to Rs. 10 Crore per borrower for loans and venture debt.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: DPIIT-recognized innovative startups

eligibility.notes: DPIIT-recognized startup with stable revenue or proof of concept.

program.program_name: Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro food processing Enterprises (PMFME)
program.description: Credit-linked capital subsidy for establishing or upgrading individual micro food processing enterprises under ODOP.
program.benefit_summary: 35% credit-linked capital subsidy up to Rs. 10 Lakh per unit, with 10% minimum beneficiary contribution.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Micro food processing entrepreneurs and SHGs

eligibility.notes: Existing or new micro food processing enterprise; proprietary or partnership.

program.program_name: PMKSY - Creation / Expansion of Food Processing & Preservation Capacities (CEFPPC)
program.description: Capital grant-in-aid for creating modern processing and preservation capacities and modernization of existing food processing units.
program.benefit_summary: Capital grant-in-aid of 35% in General areas (up to Rs. 5 Crore) and 50% in NER/Hilly areas.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Food processing enterprises investing in modern processing plants

eligibility.notes: Bank term loan required; minimum promoter net worth requirements per EOI guidelines.

program.program_name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
program.description: Medium-to-long term debt financing facility for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets through interest subvention.
program.benefit_summary: 3% per annum interest subvention on loans up to Rs. 2 Crore for up to 7 years, alongside CGTMSE guarantee fee coverage.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Agri-entrepreneurs, startups, FPOs, PACS, and MSMEs creating post-harvest agri-assets

eligibility.notes: Subvention available for up to 7 years on term loans up to Rs. 2 Crore.

program.program_name: Special Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme (SCLCSS) for SC/ST MSMEs
program.description: 25% upfront capital subsidy on institutional finance availed by SC/ST MSMEs for purchasing modern plant and machinery.
program.benefit_summary: 25% upfront capital subsidy (up to Rs. 25 Lakh on term loans up to Rs. 1 Crore) for acquiring modern plant and equipment.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: SC/ST-owned manufacturing and eligible service MSEs

eligibility.notes: Must be 100% owned by SC/ST entrepreneurs (or at least 51% in corporate entities).

program.program_name: Agricultural Marketing Infrastructure (AMI) / Sub-scheme of ISAM
program.description: Back-ended capital subsidy scheme for creation of scientific storage infrastructure, cold storage, and rural godowns.
program.benefit_summary: 25% capital subsidy (33.33% for women/SC/ST/NER) up to Rs. 50 Lakh to Rs. 87.5 Lakh on bank credit for storage infrastructure.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Entrepreneurs, MSMEs, farmers, and cooperatives establishing storage infrastructure

eligibility.notes: Infrastructure must be located in rural areas; institutional bank credit linked via NABARD.

program.program_name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM) - Custom Hiring Centres (CHC)
program.nodal_agency: Mechanization & Technology Division / State Agriculture Departments
program.description: Provides 40% capital subsidy to rural youth and entrepreneurs to establish Custom Hiring Centres renting farm machinery.
program.benefit_summary: 40% financial assistance (up to Rs. 10 Lakh on a Rs. 25 Lakh project) for agricultural machinery rental centres.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Rural entrepreneurs and farmer groups establishing farm machinery rental businesses

eligibility.notes: Applied online on agrimachinery.nic.in; equipment chosen from empaneled manufacturers.

program.program_name: Procurement and Marketing Support (PMS) Scheme - Trade Fair Participation
program.description: Subsidizes space rent for MSEs participating in national trade fairs, exhibitions, and expos to market manufactured goods.
program.benefit_summary: 80% to 100% space rent subsidy (up to Rs. 1.5 Lakh for general micro enterprises and Rs. 3 Lakh for special categories).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Udyam-registered Micro and Small Enterprises

eligibility.notes: Valid Udyam Registration required; applied online on pms.dcmsme.gov.in before fair commencement.

program.program_name: PMS - Vendor Development Programmes (VDP) & Buyer-Seller Meets
program.description: B2G buyer-seller meets connecting MSE suppliers directly to CPSEs, defense, and railways.
program.benefit_summary: Free/subsidized matchmaking platforms and vendor qualification with public sector buyers.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Manufacturing and service MSEs supplying components to CPSEs

eligibility.notes: Udyam-registered MSEs; registration via PMS portal for VDP events.

program.program_name: MSME Sambandh (Public Procurement Monitoring Platform)
program.description: Statutory monitoring portal tracking CPSE compliance with the mandatory 25% annual MSE public procurement mandate.
program.benefit_summary: Tender intelligence, advance annual procurement forecasts, and tracking of CPSE procurement quotas for MSEs.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: MSE suppliers seeking institutional government and public sector contracts

eligibility.notes: Open portal for public procurement data; MSEs register with Udyam.

program.program_name: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) - MSME Concessions & Fast-Track
program.description: National public procurement portal providing statutory concessions to MSEs including EMD waiver and turnover exemptions.
program.benefit_summary: 100% EMD waiver, prior turnover/experience exemptions, and access to all central/state government procurement tenders.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: All Udyam-registered Micro and Small Enterprises

eligibility.notes: Requires PAN, Udyam Registration, and active bank account.

program.program_name: NSSH - Special Marketing Assistance Scheme (SMAS)
program.description: Reimbursement scheme covering marketing, stall rent, airfare, and freight for SC/ST MSEs participating in exhibitions.
program.benefit_summary: 100% financial reimbursement of stall charges, economy airfare, and freight charges for SC/ST entrepreneurs.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: SC/ST-owned Micro and Small Enterprises

eligibility.notes: SC/ST proprietary or 51%+ partnership MSE with valid Udyam; claim filed on scsthub.in.

program.program_name: MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certification Scheme
program.description: Subsidizes certification costs across Bronze, Silver, and Gold tiers to promote Zero Defect Zero Effect manufacturing.
program.benefit_summary: Subsidy on certification cost: 80% for Micro, 60% for Small, 50% for Medium (+10% for Women/SC/ST/NER).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Manufacturing MSMEs registered under Udyam

eligibility.notes: Exclusively for manufacturing MSMEs with valid Udyam; applied on zed.msme.gov.in.

program.program_name: MSME Competitive (LEAN) Scheme
program.description: Provides 90% government funding toward consultant fees to eliminate shopfloor waste and improve manufacturing productivity.
program.benefit_summary: 90% government funding for consultant fees across Basic, Intermediate, and Advanced Lean interventions.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Manufacturing MSMEs registered under Udyam

eligibility.notes: Manufacturing MSMEs apply individually or in mini-clusters of 4-10 units on lean.msme.gov.in.

program.program_name: MSME Digital Scheme (Digital MSME)
program.description: Financial subsidy for MSMEs to adopt cloud computing, ERP, digital accounting, and IoT solutions.
program.benefit_summary: Subsidized cloud services up to Rs. 1 Lakh to Rs. 5 Lakh per enterprise for transitioning to digital workflows.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Micro, Small, and Medium enterprises digitizing operations

eligibility.notes: Udyam-registered enterprise; applied through MyMSME cloud portal.

program.program_name: Pharmaceutical Technology Upgradation Assistance Scheme (PTUAS)
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers (Department of Pharmaceuticals)
program.description: Subsidizes MSME pharma manufacturers to upgrade manufacturing infrastructure to revised Schedule M and WHO-GMP quality standards.
program.benefit_summary: Interest subvention of 6% p.a. or capital subsidy of 20% on eligible investment up to Rs. 1 Crore.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Micro, Small, and Medium pharmaceutical manufacturing units

eligibility.notes: Existing pharma MSME with drug manufacturing license.

program.program_name: NSSH - Testing & Quality Certification Fee Reimbursement
program.description: Financial reimbursement for testing products at NABL/BIS accredited laboratories and obtaining national/international certifications.
program.benefit_summary: 100% reimbursement of testing fees at NABL labs; 80% to 100% reimbursement of BIS/ISO/FSSAI fees up to Rs. 1 Lakh per certification.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: SC/ST-owned MSEs acquiring statutory product standards

eligibility.notes: Testing at NABL-accredited or government laboratories.

program.program_name: MSME Innovative Scheme - Incubation Component
program.description: Financial assistance for developing validated prototypes from innovative ideas through approved Host Institutes.
program.benefit_summary: Financial grant assistance up to Rs. 15 Lakh per approved idea for developing commercial prototypes.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Innovators, students, startups, and MSMEs with original commercial ideas

eligibility.notes: Applied online via annual Hackathon calls on innovative.msme.gov.in.

program.program_name: MSME Innovative Scheme - Design Component
program.description: Co-funds expert design consultant and student design projects to improve product aesthetics and functional design.
program.benefit_summary: 75% grant for Micro (up to Rs. 40 Lakh) and 60% for Small/Medium (up to Rs. 40 Lakh) for engaging design consultants.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Manufacturing and technical service MSMEs upgrading industrial designs

eligibility.notes: Must be paired with recognized Design Centres (e.g. NID, IISc, IITs) or qualified designers.

program.program_name: MSME Innovative Scheme - Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Component
program.description: Reimbursement of statutory registration and attorney fees for obtaining domestic and international patents, trademarks, and GIs.
program.benefit_summary: Reimbursement: up to Rs. 5 Lakh for Foreign Patent, Rs. 1 Lakh for Domestic Patent, Rs. 2 Lakh for GI, and Rs. 10,000 for Trademark.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Udyam-registered MSMEs protecting original proprietary inventions

eligibility.notes: Patent/trademark must be granted/published; claim submitted within window.

program.program_name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
program.description: Financial assistance to early-stage DPIIT-recognized startups for proof of concept, prototype trials, and commercialization.
program.benefit_summary: Up to Rs. 20 Lakh as grant for proof of concept, and up to Rs. 50 Lakh as debt/convertible debenture for market launch.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: DPIIT-recognized early-stage startups incorporated within 2 years

eligibility.notes: DPIIT-recognized startup; incorporated less than 2 years ago.

program.program_name: Entrepreneurship and Skill Development Programme (ESDP)
program.description: Organizes free and subsidized vocational, entrepreneurial, and management development training courses across India.
program.benefit_summary: Free/subsidized vocational training and entrepreneurial mentorship courses conducted through MSME-DFOs.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Aspiring entrepreneurs, youth, SC/ST, and women starting business ventures

eligibility.notes: Open to Indian citizens; special stipends/fee waivers for SC/ST/women/differently-abled.

program.program_name: SAMARTH (Scheme for Capacity Building in Textile Sector)
program.description: Demand-driven, placement-oriented skilling programme partnering with organized textile industry and MSMEs.
program.benefit_summary: Free NSQF skilling, biometric-tracked assessment, wage compensation, and job placement in textile units.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Youth and existing workers in textile, spinning, and garment MSMEs

eligibility.notes: Aadhaar-authenticated training; mandatory placement target for implementing partners.

program.program_name: ni-msme Executive & Managerial Capacity Building Modules
program.nodal_agency: National Institute for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (ni-msme)
program.description: Specialized residential and online executive management training courses in finance, marketing, and exports for MSME leaders.
program.benefit_summary: Subsidized executive management and industrial leadership certification courses.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: MSME founders, managing directors, and industrial executives

eligibility.notes: Direct course registration through annual ni-msme calendar.

program.program_name: Mahila Coir Yojana (under Coir Vikas Yojana)
program.description: Women-oriented programme providing 2 months coir spinning training, monthly stipend, and 75% subsidy on motorized ratts.
program.benefit_summary: 2-month skill training with monthly stipend of Rs. 3,000, plus 75% capital subsidy on motorized coir spinning equipment.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Rural women artisans in coconut-growing regions

eligibility.notes: Exclusively for women artisans; one spinning ratt distributed per trained woman.

program.program_name: MSE-CDP - Common Facility Centres (CFC)
program.description: Grant assistance for establishing Common Facility Centres (testing labs, design studios, tool rooms, effluent plants) for industrial clusters.
program.benefit_summary: Grant assistance of 70% (up to 80% for special categories/NER) for projects with maximum ceiling of Rs. 30 Crore.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs) formed by at least 20 MSMEs in an industrial cluster

eligibility.notes: SPV must have minimum 20 MSE members; minimum 10% SPV equity contribution.

program.program_name: MSE-CDP - Infrastructure Development (ID) Projects
program.description: Financial grant for developing new industrial estates or upgrading infrastructure in existing industrial areas.
program.benefit_summary: Grant assistance of 60% (up to 70% for special categories) up to Rs. 15 Crore for industrial estate infrastructure.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: State Industrial Development Corporations, municipal bodies, and cluster SPVs

eligibility.notes: State agency or industrial association application submitted via State Directorate of Industries.

program.program_name: ASPIRE - Livelihood Business Incubators (LBI)
program.description: Financial grant for setting up Livelihood Business Incubators providing hands-on manufacturing training on industrial equipment.
program.benefit_summary: One-time 100% grant of up to Rs. 1 Crore (for government bodies) or 50% up to Rs. 50 Lakh (for private entities).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Rural youth, micro-entrepreneurs, and industrial training institutes

eligibility.notes: Focuses on agro-rural technologies and local livelihood trades.

program.program_name: Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries (SFURTI)
program.description: Grant assistance for setting up Common Facility Centres, modern machinery, and market linkages for artisan collectives.
program.benefit_summary: Grant assistance up to Rs. 2.5 Crore (Regular Clusters: 500 artisans) and up to Rs. 5 Crore (Major Clusters: 1,000+ artisans).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Artisan clusters in Khadi, coir, bamboo, honey, pottery, and handicrafts

eligibility.notes: Artisans organize as an SPV partnered with an Implementing Agency.

program.program_name: Gramodyog Vikas Yojana (GVY) - Honey Mission & Kumhar Sashaktikaran
program.description: Free distribution of modern production toolkits (bee boxes, electric pottery wheels, toolkits) along with practical training.
program.benefit_summary: Free modern toolkits, processing equipment, and 5-10 day practical skill development training.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Rural potters, beekeepers, leather workers, and village craftsmen

eligibility.notes: Traditional craft background or certified vocational skill in the trade.

program.program_name: Coir Industry Technology Upgradation Scheme (CITUS)
program.description: Provides 25% capital subsidy on procurement of modern coir processing plant and machinery.
program.benefit_summary: 25% capital subsidy on procurement of eligible plant and machinery up to a project ceiling of Rs. 2.50 Crore.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Coir manufacturing micro, small, and medium enterprises

eligibility.notes: New or existing coir processing units; Udyam registration required.

subsidy.disbursement_type: Direct Capital Subsidy via Coir Board

program.program_name: National Handloom Development Programme (NHDP) - Weavers MUDRA
program.nodal_agency: Office of Development Commissioner for Handlooms
program.description: Concessional credit scheme for handloom weavers providing margin money assistance, 7% interest subvention, and CGTMSE guarantee.
program.benefit_summary: Margin money up to Rs. 10,000 (up to Rs. 2 Lakh for collectives), 7% interest subvention, and collateral-free credit.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Individual handloom weavers, master weavers, and handloom SHGs

eligibility.notes: Must possess valid Handloom Weaver Pehchan Card or State Directorate recommendation.

program.program_name: International Cooperation (IC) Scheme - Physical Participation in International Fairs
program.description: Financial subsidy covering economy airfare and stall charges for MSE delegations participating in international trade exhibitions.
program.benefit_summary: 100% economy airfare (up to Rs. 1.5 Lakh) and 100% stall charges (up to Rs. 3 Lakh) for foreign expos.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Export-ready Micro and Small Enterprises

eligibility.notes: Valid Udyam Registration and active IEC; max 3 international visits supported.

program.program_name: IC Scheme - Capacity Building of First-Time MSE Exporters (CBFTE)
program.description: Direct reimbursement of statutory registration and compliance costs incurred by first-time exporter MSEs for RCMC, ECGC insurance, and testing.
program.benefit_summary: 75% reimbursement of RCMC charges (up to Rs. 20,000), ECGC insurance (up to Rs. 10,000), and testing fees (up to Rs. 1 Lakh).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: First-time MSE exporters with valid Udyam and IEC

eligibility.notes: MSE must have valid IEC issued within the designated prior window; online claim on ic.msme.gov.in.

program.program_name: Market Access Initiative (MAI) Scheme
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry (Department of Commerce)
program.description: Financial assistance for international market research, Reverse Buyer Seller Meets (RBSMs), and foreign product registration.
program.benefit_summary: Subsidized stall charges, airfare support, and up to 50% reimbursement of foreign statutory product registration.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Exporter MSMEs participating in EPC-organized foreign trade initiatives

eligibility.notes: Applied through respective Export Promotion Councils (e.g. FIEO, EEPC, APEDA).

program.program_name: Transport and Marketing Assistance (TMA) for Specified Agriculture Products
program.description: Financial assistance for international freight and logistics to mitigate export disadvantages for Indian agricultural products.
program.benefit_summary: Reimbursement of international air and ocean freight charges at prescribed rates per TEU/tonnage.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Exporters of eligible agricultural and processed food products

eligibility.notes: Valid IEC; shipments to specified destinations; quarterly claims on dgft.gov.in.

program.program_name: MSME Samadhaan (Delayed Payment Monitoring & Facilitation System)
program.description: Statutory legal arbitration mechanism under Sections 15-24 of MSMED Act 2006 for delayed payment recovery against buyers.
program.benefit_summary: Statutory recovery of overdue invoices beyond 45 days with mandatory compound interest at 3 times the RBI bank rate.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: All Udyam-registered Micro and Small Enterprises supplying goods or services

eligibility.notes: Valid Udyam Registration at date of invoice; payment delay exceeds 45 days.

program.program_name: Trade Receivables Discounting System (TReDS) Framework
program.owning_ministry: Reserve Bank of India / Ministry of MSME
program.description: Electronic institutional auction platform enabling MSE suppliers to discount accepted trade invoices without recourse.
program.benefit_summary: Non-recourse, collateral-free instant invoice discounting at competitive bidding rates without blocking credit lines.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises seeking immediate liquidity on trade invoices

eligibility.notes: Udyam-registered MSME onboards an RBI-licensed TReDS exchange; buyer accepts trade invoice.

program.program_name: NSSH - Single Point Registration Scheme (SPRS) Fee Subsidy
program.description: 100% subsidy on NSIC registration and technical inspection fees for SC/ST MSEs under Single Point Registration Scheme.
program.benefit_summary: 100% waiver of application fee and technical inspection fee for NSIC Single Point Registration.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: SC/ST-owned Micro and Small Enterprises participating in government tenders

eligibility.notes: SC/ST enterprise with commercial production underway; applied via NSIC/NSSH.

program.program_name: NSSH - Bank Loan Processing Fee and Bank Guarantee Charges Reimbursement
program.description: Reimbursement of bank loan processing fees and bank guarantee commission charges incurred by SC/ST MSEs.
program.benefit_summary: 100% reimbursement of processing fees on sanctioned loans, plus 100% reimbursement of bank guarantee commission (up to Rs. 1 Lakh/year).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: SC/ST MSEs paying bank processing and guarantee fees on institutional loans

eligibility.notes: Sanctioned by scheduled commercial bank; claims submitted on scsthub.in.

program.program_name: PM-KUSUM Component A (Decentralized Solar Power Generation)
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
program.description: Setting up grid-connected renewable power plants of capacity 500 kW to 2 MW on barren or rural land.
program.benefit_summary: 25-year guaranteed Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with local state DISCOM at feed-in tariffs.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Rural entrepreneurs, farmers, cooperatives, and MSMEs setting up clean energy generation

eligibility.notes: Power plant located within 5 km of local 33/11 kV substation; DISCOM selection.

program.program_name: Support for International Patent Protection in E&IT (SIP-EIT)
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
program.description: Financial reimbursement scheme providing up to 50% of expenses in filing international patent applications for ICT and electronics MSMEs.
program.benefit_summary: Reimbursement up to 50% of total patent filing expenses, subject to a maximum of Rs. 15 Lakh per invention.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Technology MSMEs and DPIIT-recognized startups in electronics and ICT

eligibility.notes: Indigenous ICT innovation; online application filed on MeitY portal before foreign filing.

program.program_name: PMKSY - Integrated Cold Chain and Value Addition Infrastructure
program.description: Financial assistance for creating integrated cold chain and preservation infrastructure from farm gate to consumer.
program.benefit_summary: Grant-in-aid of 35% for general areas and 50% for North East / difficult areas of eligible project cost up to max Rs. 10.00 Crore.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Food processing units, FPOs, Cooperatives, Corporates

eligibility.notes: Must set up minimal facilities: Farm Level Infrastructure, Processing Facility, Distribution Hub, Refrig/Insulated Transport.

program.program_name: PMKSY - Creation of Infrastructure for Agro Processing Clusters (APC)
program.description: Grant for establishing common modern infrastructure to encourage entrepreneurs to set up food processing units.
program.benefit_summary: Grant-in-aid of 35% of eligible project cost in General areas and 50% in North East / Hilly / SC/ST areas, subject to maximum Rs. 10.00 Crore.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Project Execution Agencies (PEAs), Promoters, State Agri/Food Corporations

eligibility.notes: Agro cluster requires minimum 10 acres of land and at least 5 food processing units.

program.program_name: PMKSY - Operation Greens (Long Term Interventions)
program.description: Integrated value chain development for Tomato, Onion, Potato (TOP) and 22 notified perishable crops.
program.benefit_summary: Capital subsidy of 50% for general areas and 70% for FPOs/SC-ST in North East/Hilly states up to maximum Rs. 15.00 Crore.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: FPOs, Farmers Cooperatives, Individual Food Processors, Companies

eligibility.notes: Targeted at integrated supply chain projects handling notified horticultural crops.

program.program_name: PMKSY - Food Safety and Quality Assurance Infrastructure
program.description: Financial support for establishing and upgrading Food Testing Laboratories to ensure international safety compliance.
program.benefit_summary: Financial assistance of 50% of cost of laboratory equipment and 25% of technical civil works up to Rs. 10.00 Crore.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Private laboratories, Food industry associations, Universities, Research institutions

eligibility.notes: Laboratory must obtain NABL accreditation and FSSAI recognition within stipulated timelines.

program.program_name: PMKSY - Creation of Backward and Forward Linkages (BFL)
program.description: Financial support for creating backward and forward linkages to food processing units. IMPORTANT STATUS NOTE: Fresh project proposals are no longer being accepted under this component; ongoing committed liabilities continue where applicable. Fresh food processing opportunities should be directed toward currently applicable PMKSY components such as CEFPPC and Agro Processing Clusters (APC).
program.benefit_summary: Grant-in-aid of 35% (50% for NE/Hilly areas) for ongoing committed linkage projects. (Fresh proposals discontinued; directed to PMKSY-CEFPPC/APC).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Food processors, Retailers, Cooperatives, FPOs

eligibility.notes: Supports primary processing centres, collection centres, and distribution hubs.

program.program_name: Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund (AHIDF)
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
program.nodal_agency: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD) / SIDBI
program.description: Incentivises investments by individual entrepreneurs, FPOs, and MSMEs in dairy and meat processing, animal feed plants, and breed multiplication.
program.benefit_summary: 3% interest subvention on bank loan up to 90% of project cost with 2 years moratorium and 8 years repayment tenure, plus 25% credit guarantee.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Dairy/meat processors, Animal feed manufacturers, FPOs, MSMEs, Section 8 companies

eligibility.notes: Minimum promoter contribution: 10% for Micro/Small, 15% for Medium, 25% for other enterprises.

program.program_name: National Livestock Mission - Rural Poultry Entrepreneurship Scheme
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
program.description: 50% capital subsidy for establishing rural parent broiler/layer poultry breeding farms with hatchery units.
program.benefit_summary: 50% capital subsidy up to Rs. 25.00 Lakh for establishing rural parent poultry farm (1,000 parent birds) with hatchery and brooder unit.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Individuals, FPOs, SHGs, JLGs, Section 8 companies, Private MSMEs

eligibility.notes: Must own or lease land for minimum 10 years and obtain training or experience in poultry management.

program.program_name: National Livestock Mission - Sheep and Goat Breed Development
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
program.description: 50% capital subsidy for establishing intensive commercial sheep and goat breeding farms.
program.benefit_summary: 50% capital subsidy up to Rs. 50.00 Lakh for establishing sheep/goat breeding farms (up to 500 females + 25 males).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Individual entrepreneurs, FPOs, SHGs, JLGs, Private MSMEs

eligibility.notes: Requires land availability and housing for 100/200/300/400/500 breeding animals.

program.program_name: National Livestock Mission - Pig Breed Development Entrepreneurship
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
program.description: 50% capital subsidy for establishing commercial pig breeding units.
program.benefit_summary: 50% capital subsidy up to Rs. 30.00 Lakh for setting up pig breeding farms (100 sows + 10 boars).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Individual entrepreneurs, FPOs, SHGs, JLGs, Private MSMEs

eligibility.notes: Unit size: 100 female pigs and 10 male pigs.

program.program_name: National Livestock Mission - Fodder Production & Feed Pellet Entrepreneurship
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
program.description: 50% capital subsidy for establishing feed pelleting plants, Total Mixed Ration (TMR) plants, or silage making units.
program.benefit_summary: 50% capital subsidy up to Rs. 50.00 Lakh for establishing feed/fodder pellet plants or silage processing units.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Entrepreneurs, FPOs, SHGs, Dairy Cooperatives

eligibility.notes: Minimum capacity: 50 MT/day for TMR plants or 8 MT/day for feed pelleting units.

program.program_name: Rashtriya Gokul Mission - Breed Multiplication Farm Scheme
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
program.description: 50% capital subsidy for establishing high-yielding indigenous bovine breed multiplication farms.
program.benefit_summary: 50% capital subsidy up to Rs. 2.00 Crore for establishing high-yielding indigenous cattle/buffalo breeding farms (min 200 animals).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Individual entrepreneurs, Milk Cooperatives, FPOs, Dairy Companies

eligibility.notes: Farm must house minimum 200 indigenous milch cows/buffaloes and possess adequate green fodder acreage.

program.program_name: PM Matsya Sampada Yojana - Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS)
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
program.description: Financial assistance for modern water-recirculating intensive fish aquaculture systems.
program.benefit_summary: 40% subsidy for General category and 60% for Women/SC/ST of unit cost up to Rs. 50.00 Lakh for Medium RAS (Rs. 20-30 Lakh subsidy).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Fish farmers, Fisheries cooperatives, Entrepreneurs, SHGs

eligibility.notes: 40% financial assistance for General category, 60% for Women, SC, ST and North East beneficiaries.

program.program_name: PM Matsya Sampada Yojana - Biofloc Aquaculture Units
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
program.description: Financial assistance for high-density eco-friendly Biofloc fish/shrimp farming units.
program.benefit_summary: 40% subsidy for General and 60% for Women/SC/ST of unit cost (up to Rs. 18.00 Lakh for Medium Biofloc 7-tank unit).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Fish farmers, Fisheries cooperatives, Women SHGs, Youth entrepreneurs

eligibility.notes: Units range from 1-tank backyard setup (Rs. 1.5L) to 7-tank medium commercial setup (Rs. 18L).

program.program_name: PMMSY - Refrigerated and Insulated Fish Transport Vehicles
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
program.description: Financial assistance for purchasing refrigerated and insulated trucks for post-harvest fish transport.
program.benefit_summary: 40% financial assistance for General category and 60% for Women/SC/ST for Refrigerated Trucks (Rs. 25 Lakh cap) and Insulated Trucks (Rs. 15 Lakh cap).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Fishermen, Fisheries Cooperatives, Private transport entrepreneurs

eligibility.notes: 40% subsidy for General and 60% for Women, SC, ST, and NE beneficiaries.

program.program_name: PMMSY - Establishment of Fish Feed Mills
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
program.description: Financial assistance for establishing Mini and Medium Fish Feed Mills to ensure affordable aquafeed availability.
program.benefit_summary: 40% subsidy for General and 60% for Women/SC/ST for Mini Fish Feed Mills (Rs. 30 Lakh unit cost) and Medium Mills (Rs. 100 Lakh unit cost).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Entrepreneurs, Fisheries Cooperatives, MSMEs

eligibility.notes: Mini mill capacity: 2 tonnes/day; Medium mill capacity: 8 tonnes/day.

program.program_name: PMMSY - Open Sea Cage Culture / Mariculture
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
program.description: Financial assistance for open sea cage culture and coastal mariculture projects.
program.benefit_summary: 40% subsidy for General and 60% for Women/SC/ST up to Rs. 5.00 Lakh per sea cage unit for marine fish farming.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Traditional fishers, Coastal youth, SHGs, Marine cooperatives

eligibility.notes: Implemented in coastal waters under maritime state fisheries department permissions.

program.program_name: PMMSY - Modern Fish Retail Outlets and Kiosks
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
program.description: Financial assistance for establishing hygienic fish retail outlets and mobile fish kiosks.
program.benefit_summary: 40% subsidy for General and 60% for Women/SC/ST of project cost (Rs. 10.00 Lakh for Kiosks; Rs. 30.00 Lakh for Retail Outlets).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Fish vendors, Micro-entrepreneurs, Women SHGs, Fishers

eligibility.notes: Includes modern display counters, chill storage, and hygienic cutting stations.

program.program_name: MIDH - Integrated Pack House for Horticulture Produce
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
program.description: Credit-linked back-ended capital subsidy for setting up integrated pack houses with mechanised grading, sorting, and packing lines.
program.benefit_summary: Credit linked back-ended subsidy of 35% of project cost in General areas and 50% in Hilly and Scheduled areas (max Rs. 25.00 Lakh).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Farmers, FPOs, Agri-entrepreneurs, Cooperatives

eligibility.notes: Includes conveyer belt, sorting/grading units, washing, drying, and weighing equipment.

program.program_name: MIDH - Cold Storage and Controlled Atmosphere (CA) Storage
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
program.description: Credit-linked back-ended subsidy for establishing modern energy-efficient Cold Storage (Type 1 & Type 2) and Controlled Atmosphere facilities.
program.benefit_summary: Credit linked back-ended capital subsidy of 35% for general areas and 50% for NE/Hilly states up to Rs. 1.75 Crore (5000 MT capacity).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Agri-entrepreneurs, Cold chain operators, FPOs, Cooperatives

eligibility.notes: Must comply with technical standards prescribed by National Horticulture Board (NHB) / NCCD.

program.program_name: MIDH - Ripening Chamber for Fruits
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
program.description: Credit-linked back-ended subsidy for establishing multi-chamber ethylene-based fruit ripening facilities.
program.benefit_summary: Credit linked back-ended subsidy of 35% in General areas and 50% in Hilly/NE areas for multi-chamber ripening units (cap Rs. 50.00 Lakh).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Fruit traders, FPOs, Post-harvest entrepreneurs

eligibility.notes: Unit cost norm: Rs. 1.00 Lakh per MT capacity up to maximum 300 MT capacity.

program.program_name: Mission Organic Value Chain Development for North Eastern Region (MOVCDNER)
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
program.description: Financial assistance for organic value chain development, collection, packaging, and processing in North Eastern States.
program.benefit_summary: Financial support of 75% for FPOs/Lead Promoters up to Rs. 75.00 Lakh for setting up certified organic processing and packaging units.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: FPOs, Organic Farmer Groups, Private Agribusinesses in NE States

eligibility.notes: Exclusively applicable to units located in Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, and Tripura.

program.program_name: National Beekeeping and Honey Mission (NBHM)
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
program.description: Financial assistance for commercial scientific beekeeping, custom hiring centres, and honey processing plants.
program.benefit_summary: 50% to 75% financial assistance up to Rs. 50.00 Lakh for setting up commercial beekeeping units, honey processing, and testing labs.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Beekeepers, SHGs, FPOs, Honey processing entrepreneurs

eligibility.notes: Must be registered on Madhukranti portal / National Bee Board.

program.program_name: Formation and Promotion of 10,000 Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs)
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
program.description: Matching Equity Grant up to Rs. 15 Lakh and Credit Guarantee Cover up to Rs. 2 Crore for Farmer Producer Companies.
program.benefit_summary: Matching equity grant up to Rs. 15.00 Lakh per FPO and credit guarantee cover up to Rs. 2.00 Crore project loan.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Farmer Producer Companies, Cooperatives

eligibility.notes: Minimum shareholder members: 300 in plains, 100 in NE/Hilly areas.

guarantee.eligible_lending_institutions: Commercial Banks, RRBs, Cooperative Banks, NABKISAN

program.program_name: PM-KUSUM Component B - Standalone Solar Agriculture Pumps
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
program.nodal_agency: State Renewable Energy Development Agencies / MNRE
program.description: Subsidies for installation of individual off-grid solar agriculture pumps up to 7.5 HP capacity.
program.benefit_summary: Central Financial Assistance (CFA) of 30% (50% in NE/Hilly states) + State subsidy 30%, farmer pays only 10-40% for solar pump.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Individual farmers, Water user associations, Farmer groups

eligibility.notes: Applicable for replacing diesel pumps or new irrigation installations in off-grid areas.

program.program_name: PM-KUSUM Component C - Grid-Connected Pump Solarisation & Feeder Solarisation
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
program.description: Financial assistance for solarising existing grid-connected agricultural pumps and dedicated agricultural feeders.
program.benefit_summary: CFA of 30% (50% in NE/Hilly states) for individual pumps or Rs. 1.05 Cr/MW for feeder level solarisation, enabling surplus power sale.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Farmers, DISCOMs, RESCO developers, Panchayats

eligibility.notes: Surplus solar energy injected into the grid is purchased by DISCOMs at state-determined tariffs.

program.program_name: National Green Hydrogen Mission - SIGHT Programme
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
program.nodal_agency: Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) / MNRE
program.description: Strategic Interventions for Green Hydrogen Transition (SIGHT) is a national institutional bidding framework under the National Green Hydrogen Mission. Financial incentives for domestic manufacturing of electrolysers and green hydrogen production are awarded via competitive tenders administered by SECI, rather than direct walk-in MSME grants.
program.benefit_summary: National competitive bidding incentives for electrolyser manufacturing (Rs. 4,440/kW down to Rs. 1,480/kW) and green hydrogen production (Rs. 50/kg down to Rs. 30/kg) awarded through SECI tenders.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Electrolyser manufacturers, Green hydrogen producers, Energy developers

eligibility.notes: Allocated through competitive bidding managed by SECI.

program.program_name: PM Surya Ghar / Rooftop Solar Scheme for Commercial & Industrial MSMEs
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
program.description: Concessional debt financing and tax incentives for commercial and industrial MSMEs installing rooftop solar PV systems. Note: Direct Central Financial Assistance (CFA) capital subsidies under PM Surya Ghar apply exclusively to residential consumers; commercial and industrial MSMEs access concessional debt financing via SIDBI (4E Scheme / Rooftop Solar Financing) and accelerated depreciation benefits under the Income Tax Act.
program.benefit_summary: Collateral-free concessional debt financing up to Rs. 2.00 Crore from SIDBI (4E Scheme) and commercial banks (7.0% to 8.5% p.a.) with accelerated depreciation tax benefits for MSME rooftop solar installations.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises in Manufacturing and Services

eligibility.notes: Requires roof ownership or registered lease agreement and valid electricity connection.

program.program_name: Fund of Funds for Startups (FFS - SIDBI)
program.description: Rs. 10,000 Crore corpus providing venture capital via SEBI-registered Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) to high-growth Indian startups.
program.benefit_summary: Equity capital investment up to Rs. 50.00 Crore per eligible DPIIT-recognised startup via SIDBI partner AIFs.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: DPIIT-recognised technology and innovation startups

eligibility.notes: Startup must hold active DPIIT recognition and be incorporated in India.

program.program_name: Export Promotion Capital Goods (EPCG) Scheme
program.description: Zero customs duty import of capital goods for pre-production, production, and post-production for export-oriented manufacturers and service providers.
program.benefit_summary: 100% customs duty exemption on import of capital goods/machinery subject to export obligation (6x duty saved in 6 years, 75% for MSMEs).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Manufacturer exporters, Merchant exporters tied to supporting manufacturers, Service providers

eligibility.notes: Requires valid Importer Exporter Code (IEC) from DGFT.

program.program_name: Advance Authorisation Scheme
program.description: Duty-free import of raw materials, components, and packaging materials required for manufacturing export goods.
program.benefit_summary: 100% exemption from Basic Customs Duty, IGST, and Compensation Cess on imported inputs with minimum 15% value addition.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Manufacturer exporters, Merchant exporters with supporting manufacturers

eligibility.notes: Requires valid IEC; export obligation period is typically 18 months from authorization date.

program.program_name: Remission of Duties and Taxes on Exported Products (RoDTEP) Scheme
program.description: Rebate of un-refunded embedded central, state, and local taxes/duties incurred in the manufacture and distribution of exported goods.
program.benefit_summary: Electronic duty credit scrips ranging from 0.5% to 4.3% of FOB export value, freely transferable for paying basic customs duties.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: All manufacturer and merchant exporters exporting eligible HS code goods

eligibility.notes: Claimed directly in the shipping bill and credited to the exporter's ICEGATE ledger.

program.program_name: Startup India 100% Tax Exemption (Section 80-IAC)
program.description: 100% income tax deduction on profits derived from eligible business for 3 consecutive assessment years out of 10 years.
program.benefit_summary: 100% tax holiday on corporate profits for 3 consecutive years for IMB-certified DPIIT startups.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Eligible DPIIT-recognised Private Limited Companies and LLPs incorporated after April 1, 2016

eligibility.notes: Turnover must not exceed Rs. 100 Crore in any financial year since incorporation.

program.program_name: MeitY TIDE 2.0 (Technology Incubation and Development of Entrepreneurs)
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
program.description: Financial and mentoring support to tech startups utilizing emerging technologies (AI, IoT, Blockchain, Robotics, Cybersecurity).
program.benefit_summary: EiR fellowship grant up to Rs. 4.00 Lakh and Grant-in-Aid for Proof-of-Concept validation up to Rs. 7.00 Lakh per startup.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Tech innovators, Deep-tech startups, Student entrepreneurs

eligibility.notes: Must be incubated with one of the empaneled TIDE 2.0 incubation centres.

program.program_name: MeitY SAMRIDH Scheme (Startup Accelerator of MeitY for Product Innovation, Development and Growth)
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
program.description: Matching acceleration funding and scaling support for existing software and hardware product startups.
program.benefit_summary: Matching acceleration grant / funding up to Rs. 40.00 Lakh per startup via empaneled accelerators, matched 1:1 with venture capital.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Early-stage growth tech startups with validated MVP

eligibility.notes: Startup must have a working product/MVP and proof of market traction.

program.program_name: Scheme for Promotion of Manufacturing of Electronic Components and Semiconductors (SPECS)
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
program.description: Financial incentive of 25% on capital expenditure for manufacturing electronic components, semiconductors, ATMP, and specialized assemblies. IMPORTANT STATUS NOTE: The window for submitting fresh applications closed on 31 March 2024; existing approved projects continue through implementation, milestone verification, and eligible incentive disbursement.
program.benefit_summary: 25% financial reimbursement of eligible capex on plant, machinery, and utilities for approved projects. (Fresh application window closed on 31 March 2024; active for ongoing execution and disbursement).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Electronic component manufacturers, Semiconductor packaging/ATMP companies

eligibility.notes: Minimum investment threshold ranges from Rs. 5 Crore to Rs. 1,000 Crore depending on the component category.

program.program_name: Design Linked Incentive (DLI) Scheme for Semiconductor Design
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
program.description: Financial incentives and design infrastructure support for domestic semiconductor and fabless chip design companies.
program.benefit_summary: Reimbursement up to 50% of eligible design expenditure (cap Rs. 15.00 Crore) and 6% to 4% deployment-linked incentive on net sales (cap Rs. 30.00 Crore).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Domestic semiconductor startups, MSMEs, Fabless design companies

eligibility.notes: Entity must be majority owned (more than 50%) by Indian citizens.

program.program_name: PM Mega Integrated Textile Region and Apparel (PM MITRA) Parks Scheme
program.description: World-class integrated industrial infrastructure with plug-and-play facilities and Competitive Incentive Support (CIS) for textile units.
program.benefit_summary: Development Capital Support up to Rs. 500 Crore per park and Competitive Incentive Support up to Rs. 300 Crore (up to Rs. 30 Cr per unit).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Textile manufacturing units, Apparel exporters, Technical textile producers

eligibility.notes: Units must locate within designated PM MITRA Parks across the 7 selected state sites.

program.program_name: Silk Samagra 2 - Integrated Scheme for Development of Silk Industry
program.description: 50% to 75% financial assistance for mulberry and vanya sericulture, automated reeling units (ARM), and silk processing machinery.
program.benefit_summary: 50% to 75% subsidy on rearing appliances, automatic reeling machines, twisting units, and seed production (up to Rs. 35.00 Lakh).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Sericulturists, Silk reelers, Weavers, MSME silk units

eligibility.notes: Higher subsidy (up to 75-80%) applicable for SC/ST and North Eastern beneficiaries.

program.program_name: National Handloom Development Programme - Block Level Clusters (BLC)
program.description: Financial grant for setting up Common Facility Centres, technological upgradation of looms/jacquards (up to 90% subsidy), and design interventions.
program.benefit_summary: Grant assistance up to Rs. 2.00 Crore per cluster for common facility centres, skill training, and 90% subsidy for modern looms/jacquards.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Handloom weavers, Self Help Groups, Primary Weavers Cooperatives

eligibility.notes: Weavers must hold Handloom Weaver Pehchan card.

program.program_name: Ambedkar Hastshilp Vikas Yojana (AHVY) for Handicrafts Artisans
program.description: Comprehensive cluster development for handicraft artisans covering baseline surveys, modern toolkit distribution (100% subsidy), and CFC creation.
program.benefit_summary: Cluster assistance up to Rs. 1.50 Crore covering skill upgradation, design clinics, 100% toolkit subsidy, and market exhibitions.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Handicraft artisans, SHGs, Producer Companies, Artisan Cooperatives

eligibility.notes: Artisans must hold DC(Handicrafts) Artisan Pehchan identity card.

program.program_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Textiles
program.description: Production Linked Incentive of 3% to 15% on incremental sales turnover for Man-Made Fibre (MMF) fabrics, garments, and Technical Textiles.
program.benefit_summary: Incentive of 3% to 15% on incremental turnover for 5 consecutive years with minimum investment of Rs. 100 Cr (Part 2) or Rs. 300 Cr (Part 1).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Textile manufacturing companies, Technical textile producers

eligibility.notes: Requires minimum Rs. 100 Cr investment and minimum 25% incremental turnover YoY.

program.program_name: DST NIDHI-PRAYAS (Promoting and Accelerating Young and ASpiring innovators)
program.nodal_agency: Department of Science and Technology (DST) / SINE IIT Bombay
program.description: Proof-of-concept grant support to convert an innovative hardware idea into a working physical prototype.
program.benefit_summary: Prototype grant-in-aid support up to Rs. 10.00 Lakh per innovator/startup along with fabrication lab access in PRAYAS Centres.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Individual innovators, Early-stage hardware and technology startups

eligibility.notes: Targeted at physical hardware/embedded product innovations with technical feasibility.

program.program_name: DST NIDHI-EIR (Entrepreneurs-in-Residence) Fellowship
program.description: Monthly fellowship grant to support aspiring technology entrepreneurs while developing their startup venture full-time.
program.benefit_summary: Monthly grant up to Rs. 30,000 per month for up to 18 months (total up to Rs. 5.40 Lakh) with dedicated mentorship and incubation support.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Full-time technology entrepreneurs and graduating engineers

eligibility.notes: Applicant must not be in receipt of any other salary or fellowship and commit full-time to the venture.

program.program_name: BIRAC Biotechnology Ignition Grant (BIG) Scheme
program.nodal_agency: Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC) / DBT
program.description: Equity-free grant-in-aid funding for biotech, medtech, diagnostics, and agri-biotech startups to establish proof-of-concept.
program.benefit_summary: Equity-free grant-in-aid up to Rs. 50.00 Lakh for up to 18 months for biotech and healthcare startups.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Biotech startups, Medtech innovators, Bio-entrepreneurs

eligibility.notes: Startup must be incorporated less than 5 years ago with minimum 51% Indian citizen shareholding.

program.program_name: BIRAC Small Business Innovation Research Initiative (SBIRI)
program.nodal_agency: Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC) / DBT
program.description: Financial support for early-stage innovation and late-stage pre-commercialisation research by Indian biotech SMEs and startups.
program.benefit_summary: Grant-in-aid funding up to Rs. 5.00 Crore (up to 50% of project cost) for high-risk biotechnology industrial R&D.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Registered Indian biotech companies, SMEs with DSIR-recognised in-house R&D units

eligibility.notes: Minimum 51% shareholding must be held by Indian citizens/promoters.

program.program_name: NSTFDC Term Loan Scheme for Scheduled Tribe Entrepreneurs
program.nodal_agency: National Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation (NSTFDC)
program.description: Concessional credit up to 90% of project cost for Scheduled Tribe entrepreneurs for setting up viable income-generating enterprises.
program.benefit_summary: Term loan assistance up to Rs. 50.00 Lakh per unit at subsidized interest rate of 6% to 8% p.a. for Scheduled Tribe entrepreneurs.

eligibility.notes: Applicant must possess valid Scheduled Tribe certificate issued by competent authority.

program.program_name: NMDFC Term Loan Scheme for Minority Entrepreneurs
program.nodal_agency: National Minorities Development and Finance Corporation (NMDFC)
program.description: Concessional credit for notified minorities (Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, Parsis) to set up commercial and manufacturing enterprises.
program.benefit_summary: Concessional term loan up to Rs. 20.00 Lakh at 6% to 8% interest rate for notified minority entrepreneurs.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Notified minority individuals, artisans, and women entrepreneurs

eligibility.notes: Belonging to notified minority community with annual family income up to Rs. 3 Lakh (Credit Line 1) or Rs. 8 Lakh (Credit Line 2).

program.program_name: NMDFC Virasat Scheme for Minority Artisans and Craftsmen
program.nodal_agency: National Minorities Development and Finance Corporation (NMDFC)
program.description: Concessional credit for craft equipment, raw materials, and working capital for traditional minority artisans.
program.benefit_summary: Concessional credit up to Rs. 10.00 Lakh for craft equipment and working capital at highly subsidized interest rate of 5% p.a. (4% for female artisans).
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Notified minority craftspersons, traditional artisans, weavers

eligibility.notes: Must be practicing traditional crafts/arts and belong to a notified minority community.

program.program_name: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC)
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
program.nodal_agency: IFCI Venture Capital Funds Ltd / MoSJE
program.description: Equity and quasi-equity financial support to foster entrepreneurship and innovation among Scheduled Castes.
program.benefit_summary: Equity and quasi-equity funding from Rs. 20.00 Lakh up to Rs. 15.00 Crore per enterprise with 60%+ SC shareholding.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs, Companies with 60%+ SC equity ownership

eligibility.notes: Minimum 60% shareholding must be held by SC entrepreneurs with management control for at least 12 months.

program.program_name: Venture Capital Fund for Backward Classes (VCF-BC)
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
program.nodal_agency: IFCI Venture Capital Funds Ltd / MoSJE
program.description: Concessional equity and debt financing for scalable commercial enterprises owned by Backward Classes.
program.benefit_summary: Concessional equity and debt funding from Rs. 20.00 Lakh up to Rs. 5.00 Crore for companies with 60%+ OBC shareholding.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: OBC entrepreneurs, Companies with 60%+ OBC equity ownership

eligibility.notes: Minimum 60% shareholding must be held by OBC entrepreneurs with management control for at least 12 months.

program.program_name: Credit Enhancement Guarantee Scheme for Scheduled Castes (CEGSSC)
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
program.description: Credit enhancement guarantee cover for term loans and working capital sanctioned to SC-owned enterprises.
program.benefit_summary: 100% guarantee cover on collateral-free loans from Rs. 15.00 Lakh up to Rs. 5.00 Crore sanctioned to SC entrepreneurs.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: SC entrepreneurs, SC-owned MSMEs with 51%+ SC shareholding

eligibility.notes: Enterprises must have minimum 51% SC shareholding with management control.

guarantee.eligible_lending_institutions: Scheduled Commercial Banks, State Financial Corporations

program.program_name: RAMP - Green Investment and Financing for Transformation (GIFT) Scheme
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
program.description: Concessional green credit and interest subvention for MSMEs investing in clean energy, energy efficiency, and rooftop solar.
program.benefit_summary: Concessional green loans with interest subvention up to 2.50% and technical consulting support for energy efficiency upgrades.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Manufacturing and services MSMEs with valid Udyam registration

eligibility.notes: Requires valid Udyam Registration and energy audit / green technology adoption plan.

program.program_name: RAMP - MSE Scheme for Promotion of Investment, Clean Energy and Circular Economy (MSE-SPICE)
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
program.description: 25% capital subsidy for Micro and Small Enterprises investing in circular economy, waste recycling, and pollution abatement.
program.benefit_summary: 25% capital subsidy up to Rs. 50.00 Lakh for MSEs investing in circular economy, waste recycling, and effluent treatment systems.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Micro and Small manufacturing enterprises

eligibility.notes: Must possess active Udyam registration in micro or small manufacturing category.

program.program_name: MSME Intellectual Property Facilitation Centre (IPFC) Sub-Component
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
program.description: Sub-component under MSME Innovative Scheme (IPR Component) providing financial support for establishing Intellectual Property Facilitation Centres (IPFCs) and IP awareness/reimbursement for MSMEs.
program.benefit_summary: Financial support up to Rs. 1.00 Crore for establishing IPFCs and reimbursement support for patents, trademarks, and GIs under MSME Innovative Scheme.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises with Udyam registration

eligibility.notes: Reimbursement is claimed post grant/registration of IPR through MSME Champions portal.

program.program_name: Coir Board - Raw Material Bank (RMB) Scheme
program.owning_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
program.description: Financial assistance for setting up Raw Material Banks to maintain buffer stocks of coir yarn, fibre, and pith for small coir spinners.
program.benefit_summary: Financial assistance of 50% of the cost of setting up Raw Material Banks up to Rs. 50.00 Lakh to ensure uninterrupted raw material supply.
program.target_beneficiary_summary: Coir producers, Coir Cooperatives, Coir Consortiums

eligibility.notes: Operated by Coir Consortiums or State Coir Corporations.
